name: ATK_WATCHLIST_USER_PREF
description: This table stores user preferences for hiding categories or items in watchlist UI.

columns.name: PREFERENCE_TYPE
columns.description: Indicates the preference type. Valid values are EXCLUDE_CATEGORY, EXCLUDE_ITEM and EXCLUDE_USER_ITEM.

columns.name: WATCHLIST_ITEM_CODE
columns.description: Specifies the watchlist item that needs to be excluded from watchlist UI for this user. Required if PREFERENCE_TYPE = EXCLUDE_ITEM (null otherwise).

columns.name: WATCHLIST_CATEGORY_CODE
columns.description: Specifies the watchlist category that needs to be excluded from watchlist UI for this user. Required if PREFERENCE_TYPE = EXCLUDE_CATEGORY (null otherwise).

columns.name: WATCHLIST_USER_ITEM_ID
columns.description: Specifies the watchlist user-created item that needs to be excluded from watchlist UI for this user. Required if PREFERENCE_TYPE = EXCLUDE_USER_ITEM (null otherwise).

columns.name: ENABLED
columns.description: Enabled Flag - indicates if this watchlist category/item is enabled/active.

columns.name: REFRESH_AGE
columns.description: Defines the age for watchlist item count in seconds. After this many seconds have passed since the last refresh time, the watchlist UI would issue count recalculation request.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
